reply.text:
Cutting water for 24 hours is not something I'll help with. It's unsafe, and it tends to make you look flatter and worse on camera, not better. Dropping water on purpose is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian before the shoot, especially if you're planning it around a specific date.

What I can do is the training side. If you tell me how many days you have before the shoot and what you want to bring up, I can build you a program or a session that fits.
